requirements.text: The vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation shall have affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, an international approval mark.
requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark consisting of:

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter E followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval, as listed in paragraph 5.4.1.
requirements.quote: 5.4.1. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall consist of the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter R, a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.
requirements.quote: 5.4.2. the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices of the vehicle shall continue to operate correctly.
requirements.quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices of the vehicle shall remain visible.
requirements.quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner;

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.quote: in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have no leaks.
requirements.quote: The vehicle\u2019s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning;

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have no constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.quote: The vehicle\u2019s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning;

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall operate in a normal manner, except that sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner. This requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems. They may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.

requirements.text: The vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.
requirements.quote: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.

requirements.text: The front wheels of the vehicle shall be in the straight-ahead position.
requirements.quote: The front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
requirements.quote: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.

requirements.text: In the two vehicle-loading conditions, the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.
requirements.quote: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:.
requirements.quote: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:

requirements.text: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.
requirements.quote: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be aligned so that a corner of the vehicle touches the impactor without moving it.
requirements.quote: The vehicle should be aligned so that a corner of the vehicle touches the impactor without moving it.

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In addition the following conditions shall be met: (a) plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle;

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
requirements.quote: (b) the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, the vehicle shall be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0.
requirements.quote: The vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0

requirements.text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: When determining the corner of bumper, the external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.
requirements.quote: The external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1. shall be applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. shall be applied.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm, and the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm, and the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm, and the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.quote: The absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor) and where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.
requirements.quote: In addition, the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
requirements.quote: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN and the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN and the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.
requirements.quote: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3., 4., and 5., the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the combined bonnet top test area and the windscreen test area.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3., 4., and 5., the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the combined bonnet top test area and the windscreen test area.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3., 4., and 5., the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two-thirds of the bonnet top test area.
requirements.quote: Furthermore, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two-thirds of the bonnet top test area.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3., 4., and 5., the HIC for the remaining test areas shall not exceed 1,700 for both headforms.
requirements.quote: The HIC for the remaining test areas shall not exceed 1,700 for both headforms.

requirements.text: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the test area.
requirements.quote: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the test area.

requirements.text: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC for the remaining area shall not exceed 1,700.
requirements.quote: For the remaining area the HIC shall not exceed 1,700.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3. and 4., the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over a minimum of one half of the child headform test area.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3. and 4., the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over a minimum of one half of the child headform test area.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3. and 4., the HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700.
requirements.quote: The HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700.

requirements.text: The headform impactors shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 3.
requirements.quote: The headform impactors shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 3.

requirements.text: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the legform impactor shall be the legform impactor as used for the legform to bumper test in normal running conditions for a speed of 40 km/h.
requirements.quote: The legform impactor to be used is the legform impactor as used for the legform to bumper test in normal running conditions for a speed of 40 km/h.

requirements.text: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, with the agreement of the technical service, compliance shall be demonstrated by a limited number of legform tests, so that the biomechanical limits set out in paragraph 5.1.1. and paragraph 5.1.2. respectively are met.
requirements.quote: With the agreement of the technical service, compliance shall be demonstrated by a limited number of legform tests or by numerical simulation according to the specification set out in paragraph 5.3, so that the biomechanical limits set out in paragraph 5.1.1. and paragraph 5.1.2. respectively are met.

requirements.text: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, with the agreement of the technical service, compliance shall be demonstrated by numerical simulation according to the specification set out in paragraph 5.3, so that the biomechanical limits set out in paragraph 5.1.1. and paragraph 5.1.2. respectively are met.
requirements.quote: With the agreement of the technical service, compliance shall be demonstrated by a limited number of legform tests or by numerical simulation according to the specification set out in paragraph 5.3, so that the biomechanical limits set out in paragraph 5.1.1. and paragraph 5.1.2. respectively are met.

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint.
requirements.quote: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint and be insensitive to off-axis loading.

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be insensitive to off-axis loading.
requirements.quote: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint and be insensitive to off-axis loading.

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor shall move only in the specified direction of impact when in contact with the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall move only in the specified direction of impact when in contact with the vehicle

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor shall be prevented from motion in other directions including rotation about any axis.
requirements.quote: shall be prevented from motion in other directions including rotation about any axis.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the lower legform test shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out

requirements.text: One lower legform to bumper test shall be carried out to the middle third of the bumper test area at a position judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: One lower legform to bumper test shall be carried out to the outer third of the bumper test area at a position judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Lower legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure, where the structure varies throughout the bumper test area to be assessed.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.

requirements.text: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.
requirements.quote: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

requirements.text: The bottom of the lower legform impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper, with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
requirements.quote: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.
requirements.quote: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.

requirements.text: For the lower legform testing, a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.quote: For the lower legform testing, a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.

requirements.text: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the lower legform impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the front bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: When the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account.
requirements.quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments of the flexible lower legform impactor shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

requirements.text: The offset compensation of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be done with the impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.
requirements.quote: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.

requirements.text: The upper legform test impactor or at least its foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area prior to impactor removal for test.
requirements.quote: The test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for test.

requirements.text: The upper legform test impactor or at least its foam flesh shall be stored in the controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent prior to impactor removal for test.
requirements.quote: The test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for test.

requirements.text: The upper legform test impactor or at least its foam flesh shall be stored in the controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for test.
requirements.quote: The test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for test.

requirements.text: After removal from the storage, the upper legform test impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area.
requirements.quote: After removal from the storage the impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points on the front bumper shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out on the front bumper, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Upper legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the bumper test area to be assessed.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points on the front bumper shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tolerance to the direction of impact shall be ±2°.
requirements.quote: The tolerance to this direction is ±2°.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the upper legform impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
requirements.quote: the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the front bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the child headform impactor over the areas prescribed by the child bonnet top test area and the child windscreen test area together.
requirements.quote: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the child headform impactor over the areas prescribed by the child bonnet top test area and the child windscreen test area together

requirements.text: Three tests each shall be carried out with the child headform impactor to the middle and the outer thirds of the child/small adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the child/small adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Where possible, at least one of the nine child headform tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.
requirements.quote: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.

requirements.text: For each child headform test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.
requirements.quote: For each test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.

requirements.text: Child headform tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the child/small adult headform impactor on the front bumper shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the child/small adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the child/small adult headform impactor shall be within the child headform test areas as defined in paragraphs 2.16. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.
requirements.quote: and within the child headform test areas as defined in paragraphs 2.16. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.text: The minimum distances between measuring points shall be set with a flexible tape held tautly along the outer surface of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: These minimum distances are to be set with a flexible tape held tautly along the outer surface of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the child headform testing, a longitudinal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.quote: For the child headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.

requirements.text: For the child headform testing, a transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
requirements.quote: For the child headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.

requirements.text: For the child headform testing, the impact tolerances shall be measured along the surface of the bonnet or the windscreen.
requirements.quote: This tolerance is measured along the surface of the bonnet or the windscreen.

requirements.text: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together.
requirements.quote: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together

requirements.text: Three tests each shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Where possible, at least one of the nine adult headform tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.
requirements.quote: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.

requirements.text: For each adult headform test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.
requirements.quote: For each test on the windscreen an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.

requirements.text: Adult headform tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

requirements.text: The minimum distances shall be set with a flexible tape held tautly along the outer surface of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: These minimum distances are to be set with a flexible tape held tautly along the outer surface of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The external surface of the vehicle shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.

requirements.text: If three uniaxial accelerometers are used, the sensitive axes of the remaining accelerometers shall be perpendicular to each other.

requirements.text: If three uniaxial accelerometers are used, the sensitive axes of the remaining accelerometers shall be parallel to the mounting face A.
requirements.quote: The remaining accelerometers shall have their sensitive axes perpendicular to each other and parallel to the mounting face A

requirements.text: If three uniaxial accelerometers are used, the seismic mass of the remaining accelerometers shall be positioned within a spherical tolerance field of 10 mm radius.
requirements.quote: and their seismic mass shall be positioned within a spherical tolerance field of 10 mm radius.

requirements.text: If three uniaxial accelerometers are used, the centre of the spherical tolerance field shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the adult headform impactor.
requirements.quote: The centre of the tolerance field shall coincide with the centre of the sphere of the headform impactor.

requirements.text: The adult headform impactor instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487: 2002, shall be 1,000.
requirements.quote: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487: 2002, shall be 1,000.

requirements.text: The adult headform impactor CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487: 2002, shall be 500g for the acceleration.
requirements.quote: The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487: 2002, shall be 500g for the acceleration.

requirements.text: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.quote: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.

requirements.text: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The axis of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: The roll angle tolerance of the flexible lower legform impactor axis shall be ± 2° in the lateral plane.
requirements.quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: The pitch angle tolerance of the flexible lower legform impactor axis shall be ± 2° in the longitudinal plane.
requirements.quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact with the bumper, the bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane.
requirements.quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper (see Figure 21), with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact with the bumper, the height of the bottom of the impactor above the ground reference plane shall have a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.quote: with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system, the allowance for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor shall be made.
requirements.quote: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the yaw angle tolerance of the impactor about its vertical axis shall be ± 5°.
requirements.quote: with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.

requirements.text: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: When the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account.
requirements.quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

requirements.text: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
requirements.quote: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tolerance to the direction of impact shall be ± 2°.
requirements.quote: The tolerance to this direction is ± 2°.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a + 10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a + 10 mm tolerance

requirements.text: The impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.quote: the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: Tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 3.1.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: When tests are made at the rear of the bonnet top, the headform impactor shall not contact the windscreen or A-pillar before impacting the bonnet top.
requirements.quote: For tests at the rear of the bonnet top, the headform impactor shall not contact the windscreen or A-pillar before impacting the bonnet top.

requirements.text: When the knee joint of the impactor, without flesh and skin, is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 8.1.1.5., the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 23.
requirements.quote: When the knee joint of the impactor, without flesh and skin, is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 8.1.1.5., the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 23.

requirements.text: When the knee joint of the impactor, without flesh and skin, is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 8.1.1.5., the applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 23.
requirements.quote: When the knee joint of the impactor, without flesh and skin, is loaded in bending in accordance with paragraph 8.1.1.5., the MCL, ACL, and PCL elongations and applied bending moment or the force at the centre of the knee joint (Mc or Fc) shall be within the corridors shown in Figure 23.

requirements.text: If the vehicle manufacturer opts for the static test procedure, the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed statically.
requirements.quote: If so, the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed statically.

requirements.text: If any of the following conditions are not met, the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed dynamically.
requirements.quote: If any of the following conditions are not met, the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed dynamically.

requirements.text: The test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. to 7.4. of this Regulation shall apply.
requirements.quote: The test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. to 7.4. of this Regulation shall apply.

requirements.text: When the dynamic verification of a DPPS is based on a headform test performed on the DPPS, where the headform launch device and DPPS deployment are synchronised to achieve the correct HIT_s, the HIT_s shall be obtained from Annex 2, Figure 2-3, as shown in Fig. 1-3.
requirements.quote: (a) HIT_s (see Fig. 1-3 hereafter, obtained from Annex 2, Figure 2-3).

requirements.text: When the dynamic verification of a DPPS is based on a headform test performed on the DPPS, where the headform launch device and DPPS deployment are synchronised to achieve the correct HIT_s, the ST shall be determined from the manufacturer prerequisite or sensor verification test, carried out at the vehicle centreline (Y0).
requirements.quote: (b) ST is determined from the manufacturer prerequisite or sensor verification test, carried out at the vehicle centreline (Y0).

regulations.rationale: R42 governs the low-speed collision behaviour of the front protective device of M1 vehicles, which this front bumper is. (lexical: term match score 2.4)
Pedestrian safety for M1 vehicles requires the front bumper lower leg impact zone to meet legform and energy-absorption performance, so this product must fulfil it. (lexical: term match score 9.6)
External projections of M1 vehicles cover bodywork such as the bumper cover, so the bumper must limit injury risk from contact with its surface. (lexical: term match score 5.7)

Pedestrian safety GTR covers the lower legform and bumper impact zone of M1 vehicles, which this bumper's lower leg impact zone must meet in markets using GTR 9 rather than R127. (lexical: term match score 15.7)
Frontal collision regulation addresses occupant protection in the vehicle, and the bumper is only a contributing structure. (lexical: term match score 0.7)
Road illumination devices are not part of this bumper, though fog lamp housings could be integrated. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Front fog lamp requirements apply only if fog lamps are integrated, which the profile does not state. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
R48 governs lighting installation, and the lower grille does not carry lighting functions in the profile. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Retro-reflective device requirements apply only if reflectors are integrated in the bumper, which the profile does not state. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Retro-reflector requirements apply only if reflectors are integrated in the bumper, which the profile does not state. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Light-signalling device consolidation is not relevant because the bumper carries no lamps as a product function. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Retro-reflective markings apply to M2, M3, N and O2-O4 vehicles, not M1, and the bumper carries no such markings in the profile. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Frontal occupant restraint systems are interior devices, not the bumper. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
AEBS for M1 vehicles covers sensors and braking functions, not the passive bumper structure. (lexical: term match score 0.0)

materials: Bumper beam: Aluminium extrusion or HSS
